## About SACSCOC Reaffirmation

The Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC) is the regional accreditor for degree-granting higher education institutions in the Southern states. Reaffirmation of accreditation occurs on a **10-year cycle** and involves:

1. **Compliance Certification** — Self-assessment against all SACSCOC Standards
2. **Quality Enhancement Plan (QEP)** — A focused initiative to improve student learning
3. **Off-Site Review** — Peer evaluation of the Compliance Certification
4. **On-Site Visit** — Peer evaluators visit campus to verify compliance
5. **Board Action** — SACSCOC Board of Trustees determines accreditation status

## Core Requirements

SACSCOC designates certain standards as **Core Requirements** — the most fundamental aspects of institutional quality. These are marked throughout this site with a special indicator and require the strongest evidence.

::: {.callout-important}
## Core Requirements at a Glance

The 13 Core Requirements addressed in the Compliance Certification are:

- **2.1** Institutional Mission
- **3.1.a-c** Basic Eligibility (Degree Authority, Coursework, Continuous Operation)
- **4.1** Governing Board Characteristics
- **5.1** Chief Executive Officer
- **6.1** Full-time Faculty
- **7.1** Institutional Planning
- **8.1** Student Achievement
- **9.1-9.3** Program Content, Length, and General Education
- **11.1** Library and Learning Resources
- **12.1** Student Support Services
- **13.1-13.2** Financial Resources and Documents
:::
